newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India buys Mar 1-5 fuel oil at +$10.48/T from Fal.
newsitem.headline: India buys Mar 1-5 fuel oil at +$10.48/T from Fal.

text.p: State-owned Indian oil Corp has awarded a tender to buy 30,000-tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil at $10.48 per tonne above spot MidEast quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Bombay from Mideast trader Fal Oil, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender which sought the cargo for delivery to the Indian west coast between March 1-5, closed February 20.
India last purchased two fuel oil cargoes for delivery in February at between $10.48-$10.80 per tonne above MidEast quotes on a c-and-f basis.
India's second tender to buy three fuel oil cargoes for arrival in March closes on February 27 with offers valid to February 28.
